rules.material: Dark opaque composite surfaces with restrained luminous trim.
rules.shape: Precise geometric panels, small corner cuts and consistent thin outlines.
rules.typography: Readable technical sans serif; clear title and data hierarchy.
rules.icons: Geometric line pictograms with uniform stroke weight.
rules.decoration: Sparse technical details; luminous accents identify hierarchy without obscuring content.
rules.lighting: Controlled cyan rim highlights and restrained glow on primary actions.
